newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: SIMEX Brent rebounds amid NYMEX bounce.
newsitem.headline: SIMEX Brent rebounds amid NYMEX bounce.

text.p: SIMEX Brent December crude futures were firmer on Thursday in a rebound amid a firm NYMEX market.
December was last traded at $23.70 per barrel, up 13 cents from London's settlement of $23.57. January was last traded at $23.32, up 15 cents from London.
Brokers attributed the firmer market to a technical bounce in NYMEX prices.
The NYMEX December crude contract found buying support at $24.00 in New York and has continued firming since.
It closed at $24.28 in New York and was last traded on the after-hours ACCESS system at $24.54 per barrel -- the intraday high.
